messages:
Leah: Heads up — we're seeing audio drift (~1s) on the live feed per the attendee chat. Can we swap roadmap to after Q&A? Need someone to triage encoder. @Maria @Ravi
Maria: On it. I can see repeated dropped frames on ingest. Switching to backup encoder now.
ops-bot: 🔔 Backup encoder initiated: encoder-bkp1 — health check OK (http://ops.internal/encoders/encoder-bkp1)
Ravi: If backup has mux issues, try `systemctl restart transcoder.service` on cam01. That usually clears a hung ffmpeg.
Maria: did the restart. logs show: `av_interleaved_write_frame(): Broken pipe` — OBS -> local record fallback, pushing raw to s3 for post.
Sophie: Quick Q for Ben before we shuffle: is the roadmap slide that mentions the infra commit still accurate? If we shorten it we should avoid misleading timelines.
Ben: Yes infra commit is still on track. Let's keep roadmap at a high level today — I'll follow up with a detailed update in a doc. Leah, shorten to 10m and call out follow-up doc.
Leah: Sounds good. @Cam-Ops can you handle clipping highlights? Also need someone to DM me the final slide deck for upload after.
Cam-Ops: Clips queued, rough cuts uploading to GCS: gs://redwood-inference/allhands/2185032101/clips — will tag here when complete.
Maria: Recording fallback complete. OBS local file ~1.2GB, starting upload to s3 — ETA ~8m. I'll post to #recordings when it's up.
deploy-bot: deploy: allhands-recording-uploader job started (job-id: a73f) — progress: 0% → 6% → 34%
Sophie: I'll collect the incoming roadmap questions from the public channel and DM them to Ben so we can answer crisply during the shortened slot. Also making a quick list of action items.
Ben: Perfect. Thanks Sophie. I'll be ready to do the high-level run and schedule a follow-up doc. :thumbsup:
Leah: Final plan: open mic for 3-4 audience Qs, roadmap 10m (high level), product demos 15m. Action items: Sophie collects Qs, Cam-Ops delivers clips, Maria confirms upload. Ping me when each is done.
_meta_notes: Thread focuses on live-stream logistics, last-minute agenda change, encoder troubleshooting, and follow-ups for roadmap Qs. Messages kept short and in-channel; bots note actions.
